name: The Drowned Scriptorium of the Reef-Giants
flavor: Delve into the sunlit, submerged marble vaults of ancient giants to secure an astrological relic.

phases.narration: You cast off from the timber jetties of Azure, following Harbourmistress Ilenya Sarn's warnings and Princess Turanda's promised gold toward the outer shoals. Where the ancient giant-built sea-wall fractures into the open sea, the marble crest of the Drowned Scriptorium breaks the waves. Stepping onto the flooded steps where the water reaches your waist, you are greeted by snapping pincers and the hissing chants of coral scavengers guarding the peristyle.

Wading deeper through submerged grand archways, the sound of grinding gears reverberates through the water. Colossal brass astrolabes turn lazily on the ceiling, catching the blue light. But the mechanism is not abandoned: salvage-harpooners perch atop the rusted cogwheels, ready to hook intruders and drag them into the electrified machinery.

You breach the central sanctuary: an immense domed chamber where the water is calm and crystalline. At the chamber's apex sits the Gilded Star-Chart, its brass planetary spheres aligned to constellations long forgotten. Floating before the dais is the Scriptorium's ancient guardian—an animated giant-wrought astromancer draped in kelp and starlight, flanked by an immovable carapace warder.
